identity: ONE original four-legged construct, the Heliostat Pathfinder veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the ivory enamel and brass jointed body, the slim upright torso with a pointed closed avian visor with a blue eye and gold crown points, the broad hinged blue-violet solar-array fans spreading from the back, EXACTLY FOUR articulated walking legs with split blue crystal feet under the compact body, and the near arm ending in ONE short integrated forearm blade with a round blue lens and a gold spear point. No hand-held weapons, rider or extra legs. Preserve the four legs, the solar fans, the visor and the forearm blade.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep the full solar fans, the blade point, the crown points and all four feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, beams, flashes, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra legs; the crystals keep only their steady glow. The construct moves at its joints and hinges; the fans and armour stay rigid and never bend or morph.

idle_h3_v1.action: A poised mechanical idle that loops. The solar fans open a little wider and fold back, the torso turns slightly as the visor scans, the blade arm lifts and lowers, and the legs shift their weight at the hinges, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. All four feet stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Stride in place on four legs through two complete cycles with light, precise steps. Diagonal pairs of legs alternate lifting at the hinges, swinging forward and planting their crystal feet while the others bear the weight. The torso stays upright and centred for engine-driven travel, the fans held steady and the blade arm low. Exactly four legs at all times. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE blade thrust toward screen right. The leg hinges bend and the blade elbow pulls back toward the ribs, then the blade is raised level aiming at screen right, the body leans forward and the arm extends in a straight thrust so the spear point reaches full extension at screen right with the solar fans spreading wide, then the arm retracts and the construct settles into the original stance. One thrust only; nothing is fired.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The torso jolts back and folds down, the fans clap closed and the leg hinges compress, then the construct springs back up, the fans reopen and it returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low on bent legs and swing the solar fans forward around the body like a shield, with the blade arm drawn in behind them, then hold the braced guard on all four planted feet. No attack and no return to the ready height.

cast_h3_v1.action: A signal salute. The construct raises the forearm blade straight up beside the visor and spreads the solar fans wide, holds the pose briefly, then lowers the blade and folds the fans back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, beam or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Shut down and collapse. The visor eye dims, the legs fold at their hinges and the body sinks down, stays crouched a moment, then settles flat onto the ground with the legs folded under it and the solar fans lying folded over the back, finishing as a still, low grounded shape with the crystals dark. The same body throughout: no explosion, no shrinking and no disappearing.
